name: U Ultra

images.credit: AnVuong1222004, CC BY-SA 4.0 via Wikimedia Commons

Body.Dimensions: 162.4 mm H , 79.8 mm W , 8 mm D

Platform.Operating system: Android "Nougat" 7.0; Android "Oreo" 8.0 with HTC Sense 8.0; Unofficial: Android 12 via LineageOS

Display.Display: 5.7 inch Super LCD5 capacitive touchscreen with Corning Gorilla Glass 5 for the 64 GB model and Sapphire crystal glass for the 128 GB model., 1440 × 2560 pixels (~513 ppi pixel density)

Cameras.Rear camera: 12 MP, f/1.8, 26mm, OIS, laser & phase detection autofocus, dual-LED (dual tone) flash, 1/2.3 in. sensor size, 1.55μm pixel size, geo-tagging, touch focus, face detection, Auto-HDR, panorama

Sound.Sound: HTC USonic, HTC BoomSound™ Hi-Fi edition, 3D Audio recording with 4 microphones, Hi-Res audio stereo recording, Hi-Res audio certified

Connectivity.Connectivity: Wi-Fi: 802.11 a/b/g/n/ac, dual-band, Wi-Fi Direct, DLNA, hotspot, Bluetooth: v4.2, A2DP, LE, GPS: Yes, with A-GPS, GLONASS, BDS, NFC: Yes, USB: v3.1, Type-C 1.0 reversible connector
